blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-Elcac) on Thursday welcomed reports that US law enforcement authorities are looking into the possible involvement of American citizens and organizations supporting communist insurgency in the Philippines.
